title: robinia pseudoacacia subsp. umbraculifera
intro: Robinia pseudoacacia subsp. umbraculifera, commonly known as a tree or shrub native to Europe, is a subspecies of the black locust (Robinia pseudoacacia). It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include being anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial. The therapeutic actions of R. pseudoacacia subsp. umbraculifera include being a natural pain reliever and a treatment for certain skin conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include isoflavones, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
